verification.validation: Focused release checks cover daemonctl with the race detector, Linux arm64 and armv7 daemonctl cross-builds, documentation, generated versions, the executor manifest, and npm package builds. The extended gate has a pre-existing Node release fixture failure on main.

changes: The active daemon log defaults to 100 MiB and retains seven rotated gzip archives. Apps can configure the active size and archive count in dsm-package.yaml with a matching CLI.
Low-priority background compression migrates legacy raw archives and retries failed attempts. Status JSON and startup diagnostics include the configured archive paths.
Reuse executor 0.53.6 with the same release digests.
